title: SVG Text elements are never rendered
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducable in Godot 4.4.1 (stable) and Godot Mono 4.4.1 (stable)

### System information

Windows 11, MacOs 15.6

### Issue description

Text elements inside SVG-strings that are converted to images using "load_svg_from_string" are not rendered. The rest of the SVG elements do still get rendered correctly. Text elements that render perfectly in the ThorVg viewer do not appear at all in Godot. (Text element support was introduced to Thor around version 13 I believe, to my knowledge Godot uses version 15).

### Steps to reproduce

put the string 
`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">`
`<text x="100" y="100">abaca</text>`
`</svg>`
inside of a .svg file. Try to render it with the ThorVg viewer (https://www.thorvg.org/viewer). It should do so correctly.
In godot create a string 'svg_to_draw' with the same content. Convert this string to an Image with:
`image.load_svg_from_string(svg_to_draw)` 
Convert this Image to a texture with:
`tex.texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)`
Now use this texture as a sprite in a godot scene. The text is not displayed.
